title: Signal: Yarn whitelists a host for unencrypted traffic
scope: A .yarnrc.yml file that declares a host on the `unsafeHttpWhitelist`, which Yarn will talk to over cleartext.
limitations: It matches a host on the `unsafeHttpWhitelist`, which Yarn will talk to over cleartext in the parsed .yarnrc.yml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A .yarnrc.yml that mentions a host on the `unsafeHttpWhitelist`, which Yarn will talk to over cleartext in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
